summary: Grande Group Limited, a BVI-incorporated Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer (FPI), filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, disclosing its election to rely on home country rule exemptions under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5615(a)(3)(A). The exemptions cover shareholder approval requirements for acquisitions, change of control, equity-based compensation, and discounted issuances of 20% or more of voting power. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital event is announced. This is a routine governance disclosure filing, not a special situation.
